correctness.rationale: The precisely normalized boundary-driven Lindblad model has an exact closed 16-real-equation Hermitian two-point system. Boundary damping plus connected hopping prove uniqueness and analyticity at gamma=0. Sympy exact rational elimination verifies the zero-dephasing current and derivative denominator and polynomial identity; the full 4-spin 16-dimensional independently coded Lindbladian agrees numerically, and all polynomial positive-y coefficients are proved positive for x>0. The unique root and endpoint laws follow by continuity and leading-order balances y_c/x -> 3/35 and x y_c -> 48. No finite numerical test is misused for an infinite statement.

value.rationale: The exact first size beyond the source’s exact L=2,3 treatments is a motivated finite chain at which neglected longer-range coherences influence the zero-dephasing onset. The result turns an unreliable limiting approximation into a sharp sign boundary and shows a counterintuitive reentrant reservoir-contact dependence: infinitesimal dephasing helps at sufficient nonzero tilt for weak or strong contact but hurts at weak tilt. A computable threshold and rigorous asymptotics are useful to choose bath strength without conflating initial slope with global optimal finite dephasing.
